verdict.rationale: DBOS is a durable-execution library/orchestration platform for building reliable backend workflows and agents; it is not itself an interactive product with a built-in AI assistant a user delegates tasks to. The AI-related evidence describes DBOS as infrastructure for hosting/orchestrating other people's agents (MCP server, OpenAI Agents integration) rather than DBOS shipping its own assistant persona, so this axis is a category error for this product.
